name: Vincenzo "Vincent" Vigliotti: sailed at Ellis Island, New York, 1903
description: A 17-year-old farm labourer, probably Vincenzo Vigliotti, arrived at New York on the Roma on 1 April 1903. The manifest says he paid his own passage, carried $20, and was going to a cousin in Newburgh, New York.
